headline: ⏳ TWO AGENTS WALKED 225 WILLOW POINT TODAY AND NEITHER HAS BEEN CALLED — one at 9:00 AM, one at noon, and it is now half past five. ⭐ THERE IS NO FEEDBACK FORM COMING ON THAT ADDRESS, EVER: it has sent three CONFIRMED notices and not one REQUESTED notice in its entire life, so the phone is the only instrument that exists here and the day is nearly spent. 🆕 MEANWHILE 2368 RIDGE TRAIL QUIETLY TOOK A FIFTH TOUR AT 3:00 THIS AFTERNOON — a new agent, one day after the fourth independent read called the price too high. · DO: call Anna C. and Lindsey H. tonight — Willow Point · WATCH: Lake Crest's brokerage file EXPIRED this morning, payment still unproven.

notes: 🔴 THE 6:25 MORNING LETTER HAS NOW MISSED TWO CONSECUTIVE DAYS AND NOTHING HAS REPLACED IT. Both mornings it started on schedule and produced nothing; both times that was confirmed by searching the inbox rather than by trusting a file. ⭐ THE COST IS NOT ONE EMAIL — several routines stopped writing to you directly and now report only through that letter, so two silent mornings are two days of a compiled picture nobody assembled.

⚠️ THE MORNING'S EIGHT-SILENT-ROUTINES ALARM IS HALF RESOLVED AND HALF STILL TRUE. Since noon the health file has filled in properly — the lead sweep, the deep Brivity sweep, the milestone watcher, the delta and the engagement run have all logged clean lines this afternoon. ⭐ But the routines that went quiet this morning never came back to write their lines, so today's record is still missing its first half. This is now a known reporting hole rather than an unexplained one.

✅ THE AFTERNOON RAN CLEAN AND ON A SATURDAY. The lead sweep has now gone roughly fourteen passes since 6 AM without a gap, the deep sweep broke a five-day import blackout and pushed fourteen verified imports, and the milestone watcher has caught every showing event inside the hour. ⚠️ One honest disclosure stands: the market-report lane deferred seven candidates over its own daily cap and the deep sweep still owes thirteen market reports it cannot send — both stated rather than buried.

callBlock.who: Anna C. and Lindsey H. — the two Willow Point agents
callBlock.why: 🔴 THE ONLY ROW ON THIS BOARD WHERE THE VALUE EVAPORATES AT MIDNIGHT. Both walked the house today — one at 9:00 AM, one at noon — from two different brokerages, on a listing that had never been toured in its first three days. ⭐ NO FORM IS COMING: this address has sent three CONFIRMED notices and zero REQUESTED notices across its whole life, so there is no feedback loop attached to it at all. ⚠️ An agent who walked a house at noon remembers it at six; by Monday she has seen nine more.

🔴 THE PERSON WAITING HERE IS ALREADY YOUR CLIENT AND HE HAS WAITED SINCE 10:39 THIS MORNING. He texted “a couple questions” — no subject, no urgency stated, which is exactly how a client opens a conversation he has been putting off. ⚠️ HIS CONDO IS ON DAY 155. ⭐ A client who has watched five months pass and still texts you first is not angry yet. That is a window, and seven hours of it are already gone.

callBlock.who: Carlos B. — asked you a valuation question today
callBlock.why: 🆕 HE ASKED YOU DIRECTLY AT 2:12 THIS AFTERNOON WHAT A PANAMA CITY BEACH HOUSE IS WORTH — a contact-form question, not an ad click, which means he typed your name on purpose. ⭐ A DRAFT IS ALREADY STAGED AND WAITING FOR YOU. 🔍 Worth knowing before you answer: contact forms on your site fire no instant alert, so this one was caught by a scheduled sweep forty-five seconds past its watermark rather than by the speed-to-lead lane.

🔥 HE CAME BACK TO YOUR SITE TODAY AFTER THIRTY-PLUS DAYS AWAY, and the return visit — never the first one — is the signal that actually predicts a listing conversation. ⭐ IT IS STILL TODAY FOR ANOTHER FEW HOURS. A same-day call on a re-engagement is the cheapest listing appointment your site produces, and it stops being same-day at midnight.

callBlock.who: Amy G. of Ethos International — 355 Comanche
callBlock.why: 🔥 DAY SEVEN ON THE STRONGEST BUYER READ THIS LISTING HAS EVER PRODUCED. She filed it herself: interested — YES, her buyers have just started looking, they really like it, and it sits at the TOP of their list. She also phoned from inside the house mid-showing, so this is a returned call rather than a cold one. ⭐ SHE LEFT “PRICED RIGHT” BLANK — the obstacle is unasked, not absent. 🔴 The one physical complaint on this file is still unanswered a week later: the basement lights would not come on. ⛔ Call rather than write; the co-op mail lane is a deliberate hold.

callBlock.who: Adin D. — the named buyer on 2368 Ridge Trail
callBlock.why: 🆕 TODAY GAVE THIS ROW A NEW REASON TO EXIST. Ridge Trail took a fifth tour at 3:00 this afternoon from an agent who has never shown it before — one day after a fourth independent read called the price too high. ⭐ ADIN ALREADY TOLD YOU IN WRITING WHERE HE WOULD BUY: a specific number under the ask, plus “Happy to have you represent me.” 🎯 A fresh tour plus a named live buyer under the ask is the exact pair of facts that moves an institutional seller.

callBlock.who: Zach of McFarlane Homes — Deer Ridge Lakes
callBlock.why: 🏗️ A BUILDER WHO CAME OFF YOUR YARD SIGN AND ASKED WHETHER THE LOTS ARE STILL AVAILABLE — the highest-value inbound this land listing has ever produced, and the callback is now four days overdue. ⭐ A builder does not buy one lot; he buys a phase. ⚠️ The perc-test records are still the number-one unanswered question on this file and he will ask for them — have the answer before you dial, not during.

callBlock.who: Brett P., Joey B. and Richerd M. — Willow Point ad buyers
callBlock.why: 🔴 THREE PAID-AD BUYERS OFF THE ONE LISTING THAT IS ACTUALLY MOVING, AND NOBODY HAS SPOKEN TO ANY OF THEM. ⭐ TODAY IS THE WHOLE ARGUMENT: that house took two tours this morning from two different brokerages. The ad works, the house shows, and the phone is the only broken link in the chain. ⚠️ One of the three hard-bounced, so on that record the phone is not merely the best lane — it is the only one that exists.

listings.status: 🔥 ACTIVE — three tours, zero feedback, zero calls back
listings.note: 🆕 THE STORY OF THE WEEKEND, AND IT IS STILL UNFINISHED AT SUPPERTIME. Zero tours in its first three days with paid ads running, then three inside twenty-one hours: yesterday 4:30 PM, today 9:00 AM, today noon — the last two from two different brokerages. A fourth booked 4:00 PM at 7:39 this morning and was killed at 7:49, ten minutes later. ⚠️ NOT ONE FEEDBACK FORM HAS COME BACK, AND NONE WILL: every other listing on this board sends REQUESTED then CONFIRMED; this address has only ever sent CONFIRMED, so there is no feedback loop attached to it. ⭐ THE PHONE IS THE ONLY INSTRUMENT AND THE DAY IS ALMOST GONE.

listings.status: 🆕 ACTIVE — fifth tour today, four “too high” reads behind it
listings.note: 🆕 THE FRESHEST EVENT ON THE WHOLE BOARD: a 3:00 PM tour this afternoon from an agent who has never shown it before — the fifth showing in thirteen days and the first since Thursday's read. ⭐ THAT ONE IS WORTH WAITING ON: unlike Willow Point, this address does return forms — two of the last four showings produced written feedback — so a fifth read may land tonight or tomorrow morning. ⚠️ FOUR INDEPENDENT AGENTS HAVE NOW SAID THE SAME THING, and the most recent added the worst staging score on this board, one out of five, plus a lever that is not a price cut: a pre-inspection, because “unknowns” is precisely what one removes. 🎯 One named live buyer sits under the ask and told you so in writing.

listings.status: 🔥 LIVE COUNTER — out, acknowledged, and the ball is theirs
listings.note: ✅ CLEANEST HOUR OF WORK ON THE BOARD TODAY, WITH A RECEIPT AT EVERY STEP. Your seller approved the counter at 9:01, you answered at 9:17, it was delivered to the buyer's agent at 10:00 with the furniture carve-out and acknowledged at 10:01. 🆕 AND THE SELLER MOVED AGAIN THIS AFTERNOON — he answered your recommendation with “mom wants to sleep on it,” so the decision is Sunday, not tonight. ⚠️ WHAT IS STILL OWED IS THEIRS: the written counter coming back and a preapproval now roughly a day late. ⭐ The honest risk is unchanged — these buyers must close their own house first, which makes this a contingency, not a closing.

listings.status: ⏰ CLOSED AT THE TABLE — now with negative proof
listings.note: 🔴 THE SILENCE BECAME A SIGNAL THIS MORNING AND NOTHING HAS RETIRED IT SINCE. Two days past the table there is still no funding or recording receipt — and at 10:29 the brokerage's own system said the transaction has EXPIRED, commission document sent, proof of payment still REQUIRED. ⭐ That is no longer an absence of news; it is the system stating that the last step never happened. One call to the closing attorney answers it, and it remains the highest-leverage call in the book.

✅ THE DATE IS SETTLED AND THIS BOARD HAD IT RIGHT: the title firm put it in writing — Friday the 28th at 4 PM at their Moody office. The brokerage system still prints 8/31; the title firm is the one that matters. 🔴 THREE ITEMS ARE STILL OPEN AND NOBODY ANSWERED IN-THREAD: survey, home warranty, septic/sewer inspection. ⭐ SEPTIC HAS LEAD TIME — a problem found on the 27th does not close on the 28th. Six days left and tomorrow is one of the two that are a weekend.

The roof report and inspection addendum went out Thursday and were acknowledged the same afternoon — the deadline you set was met. ⚠️ Friday brought a second addendum and a roof quote, and today brought more escrow and addendum traffic, but none of it advanced the deal: it is all movement on the inspection step rather than past it. ⭐ The buyers' answer is still the next thing owed, and the appraisal sits behind it.

listings.status: 🔥 ACTIVE — the one YES is day seven
listings.note: Four tours in nine days, and the pricing question is settled — five consecutive reads since the cut either called it just right or declined to argue it. 🔴 THE UNFIXED THING IS PHYSICAL AND CHEAP: the basement lights that would not come on, reported a week ago and still unanswered — probably a breaker, not a repair bill. ⭐ The strongest read this listing has ever drawn is still uncalled on day seven.

⚠️ THIRTEEN DAYS ON THE STRONGEST SINGLE WORD ANY AGENT HAS FILED ON THIS BOARD. Three reads in one weekend; two said not interested and the third answered the interest question with “Very” — not yes, very. ⭐ The price cut is verified live and the objection from both passes is square footage, not the number, so another cut buys nothing here. She is still the cheapest uncalled name in the book.

All three gates are essentially behind it. ⚠️ Two quiet items, both paperwork rather than condition: the inspection requests have sat with your seller since 8/17, now five days — and the title firm still cannot find your seller's name in title, with a third name in play on the same file.

🔴 THE MOST EXPENSIVE LISTING IN THE BOOK AND NOT ONE TOUR HAS EVER BEEN BOOKED ON IT. ⭐ TODAY SHARPENS THE POINT RATHER THAN SOFTENING IT: a $185,000 listing drew two tours in one morning off the same marketing machine that has never produced a single booking here. The comp work says the big-house ceiling in that zip is roughly $950K unless acreage carries it — which makes the silence a pricing answer, not a marketing one.

listings.status: 🔥 ACTIVE — highest lead yield you own
listings.note: No lockbox tours, but more inbound than any house on this list. ⚠️ A builder off the yard sign is still owed a callback — four days now — and the perc-test records remain the number-one gap on the file. 📅 SEPARATELY AND ALREADY ON THE BOOK: you committed to bringing the seller “ideas and thoughts” on build-and-sell versus sell-as-vacant-lots, and that is Monday's.

⭐ TODAY IS THE ARGUMENT FOR PRE-BOOKING IT. Willow Point ran paid ads for three days before anyone toured it, then took three tours in twenty-one hours once the market found it. The gap that costs money is between “photos ready” and “booked,” and it is eight days wide on this one.

pipeline.paceProjection: ⚠️ 20 CLOSED YTD ANNUALISES TO ROUGHLY 35 AGAINST A GOAL OF 45 — unchanged all week, and it stays unchanged until a funding receipt turns Lake Crest into number 21. 🔴 THAT IS NO LONGER JUST WAITING: the brokerage file on that deal EXPIRED this morning with proof of payment still required, so the one closing worth roughly half of this month's expected dollars is now flagged by the brokerage's own system rather than merely quiet. ⭐ Behind it, 195 Lake View on 8/28 and 3350 Altamont on 9/14 are both inside the window; 1709 Fieldstone on 10/23 is not. 🎯 The gap is about 1.8 contracts a week and the calendar keeps shrinking.

money.note: 🔴 THE FLAG THAT LANDED AT 10:29 THIS MORNING IS STILL STANDING TONIGHT, AND IT IS ABOUT A DEAL YOU ALREADY CLOSED. The brokerage's system marked the Lake Crest transaction EXPIRED — commission document sent, proof of payment still listed as REQUIRED — two days after everyone signed. ⭐ A commission does not pay itself out of a file the system has closed as expired; that is a call to the closing attorney and to brokerage support, not a wait. ✅ NOTHING NEW LANDED SINCE: no bank alert, no failed-draft notice and no balance warning in the last twenty-four hours. ⚙️ SEPARATE AND DATED: the brokerage share consolidation completes this weekend and the ticker changes Tuesday — the multiplier inside the money app must change with it or that page prints roughly ten times the true value. Flagged early so it never prints wrong. ⚠️ STILL OPEN FROM FRIDAY: a scheduled debt-settlement draft failed and the creditor left the door open to a smaller payment, which makes it a phone call rather than a payment. The accounting software still reads a balance the bank does not recognise; the session that unblocks it is Monday. ⚠️ Balances, amounts and account details are deliberately withheld — this page is public.

isa.decayPolicy: 🔴 EIGHTY-NINE OPEN ROWS, UP SIX SINCE LUNCH AND FIFTEEN SINCE FRIDAY, WITH EIGHTY-TWO DUE OR OVERDUE. ⭐ THE USEFUL DISTINCTION IS NOT AGE, IT IS DIRECTION: roughly a third are people actively waiting on YOU — a returned call, an answered question, a promise in your own words. Those cost relationships. The rest are prospects to chase, and they only cost opportunities. 🎉 THE STRONGEST ARGUMENT FOR WORKING THE LIST WAS MADE TWICE THIS WEEK: the listing you won came off a row overdue eighteen days, and yesterday you sent that same man a value report and net sheet before nine. 🔥 The freshest rows are still sellers — several homeowners this week disputed your own valuation on their own houses UPWARD, which is the most reliable listing signal your site produces, and a fourth arrived today. 🔍 Roughly a third of the list is still contactless address-only records queued for re-pull; a p1 to fix the form that creates them went on the board at 4:37 this afternoon.
isa.sweepCadence: every 30 minutes while the fleet is up — roughly fourteen passes since 6 AM today with no gap, on a Saturday. ⭐ THE PATTERN WORTH SEEING KEEPS PROVING ITSELF AND IT ALWAYS TAKES TWO CHANNELS AT ONCE: this morning's counter authorisation was a text read beside an email thread, and this afternoon's valuation question was a contact form that fires no alert at all, caught only because a sweep re-queried the inbox by sender. 🎯 NEITHER EXISTED IN A SINGLE CHANNEL. ✅ THE OWNERSHIP GUARD IS HOLDING — it has now correctly left several leads untouched as a teammate's and is running perfect against an ad footer that keeps naming the wrong agent. ⚠️ The thing to watch is not this lane; it is the sibling routines that ran this morning and logged nothing at all.
